profile.headline: Quality Engineer | Full Stack Developer | Cypress | Playwright | JavaScript | TypeScript | C#
profile.summary:
Results-driven Quality Engineer with a strong background in test automation, full-stack development, and leadership. 3+ years of experience designing and implementing robust automated and manual testing solutions. Expertise in Playwright, Cypress, and API testing frameworks with a proven track record of increasing test coverage and release quality. Combines strong technical skills with leadership experience, having successfully mentored teams and standardized testing practices across organizations. Passionate about quality assurance with a background in both software development and operational management.

Experienced with Playwright, Cypress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, React, Redux, Git, Agile Operations

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained automated end-to-end UI test suites using Playwright and C# with the Page Object Model, reducing manual regression effort by 25% 

Built maintained and modified automated build time UI tests with Cypress in TypeScript

Refactored legacy Cypress test suite using TypeScript, implementing advanced patterns like custom commands, interceptors, and fixtures that increased test coverage from 65% to 95%

Performed functional and regression tests of three highly used features to ensure quality releases

Created and executed test plans and cases to cover the full stack - UI, API, Microservices and Database

Troubleshoot potential issues with packages deployed to Windows servers or Kubernetes

Worked as part of an Agile team to deliver quality features in a biweekly cadence
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Test Automation Frameworks · Vue.js · Test Management · Test Execution · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Test Planning · API Testing · Branch Management · Regression Testing · Lifelong Learning · Software Testing · Test Automation · Software Development · Manual Testing · C# · Functional Testing · SQL · Test Cases · Test Strategy · Testing · HTML

positions.title: React Tech Lead
positions.description:
Designed and implemented comprehensive React curriculum, including development of full-stack applications demonstrating industry best practices and design patterns

Worked closely with other Tech Leads, Subject Matter Experts and Student Experience Managers to assess students' abilities, create development plans and- provide additional support/mentoring where needed

Designed and implemented comprehensive React curriculum, including development of full-stack applications demonstrating industry best practices and design patterns

Developed and reviewed production-quality code across React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL projects, ensuring adherence to modern development standards

Optimized teaching codebase for performance, maintainability and readability, resulting in 95% completion rate and a 30-point NPS increase

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
Teach and guide students through an 8 week foundational programming boot camp focusing on basic programming skills in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, SQL, Node, Jest, DevOps, SRE, Cryptography and Security.

Collaborate with the Program Director and Curriculum Director in editing content, suggesting and developing new content/tools.

Facilitate and deliver engaging lectures 3-5 times per week, leading in class discussion, and exercises, demonstrate concepts in a live feedback environment and field questions from students.

Guide and develop teaching assistant in giving lectures, engaging with students, daily and weekly administrative tasks and plan delivery of content.

Lead a group of 6-10 students through the course including morning standups, attendance, grading and feedback of coursework, performance evaluation and review and provide updates in weekly meetings regarding progress of those students.

Assist students with troubleshooting and debugging during independent work and prepare the next day’s content.

Prepare, administer and score weekly assessments to gauge students’ progress.

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description:
Teach and guide students through an 8 week foundational programming boot camp focusing on basic programming skills in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, SQL, Node, Jest, DevOps, SRE, Cryptography and Security.

Collaborate with the Leader of Learning and Instructors to edit the current curriculum and suggest new material.

Facilitate and deliver engaging lectures 1-3 times per week, leading in class discussion, and exercises, demonstrate concepts in a live feedback environment and field questions from students.

Lead a group of 6-10 students through the course including morning standups, attendance, grading and feedback of coursework, performance evaluation and review and provide updates in weekly meetings regarding progress of those students.

Assist students with troubleshooting and debugging during independent work and prepare the next day’s content.

Prepare, administer and score weekly assessments to gauge students’ progress.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Roll For Fun
https://rff.aturner.dev

● Full stack web app built with React, Express, Node, PostgreSQL.
● Selection tool for board gaming groups. Add your own collection, join a
group, vote on your group’s games. Game scores are aggregated and a
game can be chosen randomly from the top 10 by the leader of the group.

Savvy Travels
https://savvytravels.aturner.dev

● Worked as part of a team to design and develop full stack web application with React, Express, Node, PostgreSQL.
● Travel app for people with wanderlust and a budget. Built around a simple
and easy user experience. Plug in your budget and we will tell you where you
can go.
● Integrated four API calls, chaining results to make subsequent calls to fetch
user’s location, nearest metro area, major airports in that metro and then
flights from those locations.
● Programmed search functions to return flight results based on user input.
● Styled individual flight cards and carousel pages, programmed links to
carrier sites.

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
Oversaw daily operations of a fast casual dining environment including on premise dining, takeout, delivery, catering and bakery.

Increased food safety score from 82% average in 2018 to 93% in 2019.

Moved location from bottom 10% in company metrics in 2018 to top 50% in 2019.

Improved drive through speed of service metrics from more than 6 minutes to 5 minute average.

positions.title: Manager in Training
positions.description: Skills: Lifelong Learning · Oral Communication · Problem Solving

positions.title: Training General Manager
positions.description:
Oversee and lead all aspects of daily operations and drive the guest experience by working with and through managers, team members,  and guests.

Create a fun and engaging work environment focused on the team member experience through building of strong relationships and a culture of accountability. 

Drive company success and growth through training and development.  Train managers for other locations, drive continued learning for team members and provide an avenue for growth and development to both managers and team members by promoting an environment of continued learning. 

Highlights:
-Top ranked BWW Restaurant in Texas in 2016, #13 system-wide
-0% Manager Turnover over 3 years as General Manager
-3 of 4 direct reports promoted to next level management positions
-Increased same store sales 25% in tenure as General Manager
-Increased profits more than $300,000 from 2013 to 2016, 6.69% of sales
-Successfully trained more than 20 managers for other locations including franchise and corporate locations
-Opened two new restaurants as a member of management team – Frisco, TX and Hollywood, CA
-Maintained consistent career progression – hired as an hourly team member, progressed into management, promoted to Assistant General Manager in 2012, General Manager in 2014, and Training General Manager in 2015
-Increased Food Safety Audit score average from 68 to 86 within 6 months of arrival at new location
-Decreased Team Member Turnover 45% in first year at new location
-11% Same Store Sales growth in Q1 2019

 

Operational responsibilities include:

Sales Building 
Safety and Sanitation Standards
Profitability (P&L Management)
Business Planning and Forecasting
Cost Control
Labor Management
Quality Assurance (Food &Bev)
Guest Experience


Team Responsibilities include:

Manage Internal Training (Team Members and Managers)
Performance Reviews (Managers)
Coaching (On the Spot and Formal)
Development Plans (Managers)
Turnover
Team Member Engagement

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
Oversee and lead all aspects of daily operations and drive the guest experience by working with and through managers, team members,  and guests themselves.

Create a fun and engaging work environment focused on the team member experience through building of strong relationships and a culture of accountability. 

Onboarded trained and  mentored General Managers both external hires and internal promotes.

Led training program for newly hired managers of all levels - oversaw training of up to 5 managers concurrently for 12 weeks while continuing to oversee restaurant operations.

Decreased turnover by 67% in first six months at new location.

Increased average food safety audit score from 12% in first six months at new location.

Achieved ranking of 13 of 604 restaurants in company metrics, and #1 ranked restaurant in Texas.  Finished in top 10% of company metrics in 2015.

Increased same store sales more than 10% in 2016, increased same store sales 25% in tenure as General Manager.

Increased profits more than $300,000 from 2013 to 2016.

Directly supervised, trained, and developed up to 5 restaurant managers and up to 100 team members including performance evaluations, interviews, selection, hiring, onboarding, and disciplinary action.

Oversaw opening of two new restaurants  Frisco, TX and Hollywood, CA.
